results.title: RAG evals are the new unit tests — change my mind
results.content: Teams keep shipping RAG demos without a golden set. The engineers who skipped evals are finding out in production. Nobody asks about eval budgets until the first hallucination lands in a customer meeting.

results.title: We replaced our LLM judge with 40 golden questions
results.content: LLM-as-judge drifted after the model swap. We rebuilt CI around a golden set of real questions. Two weekends, zero regressions since.

results.title: Show r/LocalLLaMA: open-source eval harnesses compared
results.content: Compared three open-source eval harnesses on the same golden set. The difference is CI integration, not scoring.
